license_required.quote: It is unlawful for any person to engage in or offer to engage in plumbing work in this state unless the person has been duly licensed under this part or licensed in a municipality or county that issues licenses to persons to perform plumbing work only in that municipality or county

name.quote: "Board" means the state board for licensing contractors pursuant to § 62-6-104

type.quote: There is created a state board for licensing contractors, called the "board" in this part, to be appointed by the governor. The board shall be composed of nine (9) members

exams.name: Limited Licensed Plumber Examination
exams.notes: Written or oral, or both; administered by the board.
exams.quote: the applicant is entitled to take an examination to determine the applicant's qualifications. The board shall charge each applicant an examination fee as set by the board for each examination. The applicant is entitled to an examination to determine the applicant's qualifications. The examination may be written or oral, or both.

exams.name: Tennessee Mechanical Plumbing (CMC-A) License Examination
exams.notes: Requires three years of experience as a plumber or an engineering degree in plumbing or mechanical field. This is for the plumbing contractor classification.
exams.quote: to qualify for the Tennessee mechanical plumbing (CMC-A) license examination, a person must have three (3) years' experience as a plumber prior to taking the examination or have an engineering degree in plumbing or in a mechanical field.

interval_years.quote: A license expires on the last day of the twenty-fourth month following its issuance or renewal and becomes invalid on that date unless renewed.

renewal_fee_usd.quote: In no event shall the fee for an initial license exceed seventy-five dollars ($75.00) or fifty dollars ($50.00) for subsequent renewal of the license.

available.quote: Anyone desiring to be licensed as a contractor for this state who resides in a state that does not practice reciprocity with licensees of the Tennessee board for licensing contractors shall make written application on forms prescribed by the board

requirements.value: Reciprocity exists between Tennessee and states that practice reciprocity with the Tennessee board for licensing contractors. Applicants from non-reciprocal states must apply and comply with applicable requirements.

title_protection.quote: No limited licensed plumber shall be authorized to use the appellation "contractor" or any other designation that gives or is designed to give the impression that a limited licensed plumber is a contractor unless the limited licensed plumber also holds a valid contractor's license issued by the board.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Board may refuse, revoke, or suspend a license for faulty plumbing workmanship.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The board may refuse to issue or renew a license and revoke or suspend the license of a limited licensed plumber for faulty plumbing workmanship as determined by the board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Board may refuse, revoke, or suspend for gross negligence or incompetency in performing plumbing work.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: gross negligence, incompetency, fraud, dishonest dealing or misconduct in performing plumbing work

disciplinary_grounds.description: Board may refuse, revoke, or suspend for fraud or dishonest dealing.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Board may refuse, revoke, or suspend for lack of expertise.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The board may refuse to issue or renew a license and revoke or suspend a license of any person for lack of expertise

disciplinary_grounds.description: Board may refuse, revoke, or suspend for submission of false evidence in a license or renewal application.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: submission of false evidence with regard to any application for license or renewal

disciplinary_grounds.description: Board may refuse, revoke, or suspend for conviction of a felony.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: conviction of a felony, or any other conduct that constitutes improper, fraudulent or dishonest dealing or any other violation of this part

disciplinary_grounds.description: Board may refuse, revoke, or suspend for any other improper, fraudulent, or dishonest dealing or violation of this part.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: any other conduct that constitutes improper, fraudulent or dishonest dealing or any other violation of this part

bonding_required.quote: For all gas/mechanical, plumbing and excavation permits, the bond amount shall be forty thousand dollars ($40,000).

insurance_required.quote: Any application for initial licensure or for renewal of licensure also shall be accompanied by an affidavit affirming that the applicant maintains general liability insurance and workers' compensation insurance

definition_quote.value: "Plumbing work" means the construction, alteration, repair, improvement, movement, demolition, putting up, tearing down or furnishing of labor to install material or equipment within any residential or commercial building of all piping, fixtures and appliances for the supply of gas, water, liquids or disposal of waste water or sewage; provided, that there is no intent to require licensure under this part for plumbing work performed outside a residential or commercial building, including, but not limited to, utility connections or irrigation systems.
